validator_acceptance: status_contract.py exact status with zero exit and no stderr; every frozen expected result must match actual emitted-grammar acceptance
sentinel: One known unsupported lookahead. Closed converter error is retained; if a weak grammar is returned, its missing-marker acceptance must cause the enforcement gate to reject it. Never substitute it for a candidate.
full_messages_and_vectors: All complete messages and source-spelling context equal frozen predecessor; observe current native date/BOS/template framing and verify actual full prompt + 2048 output + terminal <=4096. No source cropping.
after_native_phase: then and only then run validator-only probe phase
